出了阴阳通道，吴姜第一次来到了地府。

放眼望去，地府的天空是一片沉沉的暗灰色，没有日月星辰，也没有蓝天白云，只有无数微弱的荧光点缀在天际，勉强照亮了脚下的土地，整个天地间都透着一股阴森肃穆的气息。

吴姜快速扫了一眼四周，此刻他们所处的是一个宽敞的平台，平台四周站着身着制服的阴差，神色威严，手持兵器，来回巡视着。

看来，这里就是阴差从阳间到阴间的往返通道所在。

平台前方不远处，便是赫赫有名的酆都城，城墙高大雄伟，由黑色的巨石砌成，上面刻着古朴苍劲的“酆都城”三个大字，透着一股不容侵犯的威严。

吴姜带着张亚芳走进酆都城，眼前的景象让他有些意外：城里的地面是宽阔平坦的青石板路，路上人来人往——不，应该说是鬼来鬼往，十分热闹，街边有不少的店铺，路边还有不少叫卖的小摊，乍一看，差点让他误以为是阳间的集市。

只是那些小摊上叫卖的东西，透着浓浓的阴间特色，看得吴姜心里微微发毛：有用阴魂凝聚的眼珠子串成的糖葫芦，泛着淡淡的绿光；有手骨打磨而成的小法器，刻着繁琐的纹路；还有用阴气浸泡的草药，散发着刺鼻的气味，每一样都透着诡异与阴森。

路上还有不少身着和吴姜类似玄黑色制服的阴差，手持兵器，来回巡逻，神色威严，时不时呵斥几句不守秩序的游魂，维持着城里的秩序，让这份热闹不至于变得混乱。

吴姜看得目不转睛，心里满是新奇，一时之间竟忘了自己的任务，连手里的勾魂锁链都忘了拉，脚步也下意识放慢了。

直到身边的张亚芳轻轻拉了拉他的衣角，声音怯生生地提醒：“鬼、鬼差大人，咱们该去交差了吧？别耽误了您的事。”

吴姜这才猛地回过神来，一拍脑袋，连忙收敛心神，有些不好意思地说道：“哦，对、对！差点忘了正事。”

很显然，张亚芳也看出了接引自己的鬼差大人，就是一个纯纯的新手。

他不再耽搁，向路过的一个阴差打听了一下方向，拉着张亚芳，快步朝着不远处的勾魂司走去。

After leaving the Yin and Yang Passage, Wu Jiang came to the underworld for the first time.

Looking around, the sky in the underworld is a deep dark gray. There are no sun, moon, stars, and no blue sky and white clouds. There are only countless weak fluorescent lights dotting the sky, barely illuminating the land under your feet. There is an eerie and solemn atmosphere in the whole world.

Wu Jiang quickly glanced around. At this moment, they were on a spacious platform. There were uniformed Yinzai standing around the platform, looking majestic and holding weapons, patrolling back and forth.

It seems that this is where the Yin difference passes from the Yang world to the underworld.

Not far in front of the platform is the famous Fengdu City. The city wall is tall and majestic, made of black boulders, with the simple and vigorous three characters "Fengdu City" engraved on it, exuding an inviolable majesty.

Wu Jiang took Zhang Yafang into Fengdu City, and the scene in front of him surprised him: the ground in the city was a wide and flat bluestone road, and people were coming and going on the road - no, it should be said that it was ghosts coming and going. It was very lively. There were many shops on the street, and there were many hawking stalls on the roadside. At first glance, he almost mistakenly thought it was a market in the underworld.

It's just that the things for sale at the stalls have strong characteristics of the underworld, which makes Wu Jiang's heart tremble slightly: there are candied haws skewered with eyes condensed by ghosts, glowing with a faint green light; there are small magic tools made of polished hand bones, engraved with complicated lines; and there are herbs soaked in Yin Qi, exuding a pungent smell, each of which is weird and eerie.

There were many shady men on the road wearing black uniforms similar to Wu Jiang's. They were patrolling back and forth with weapons in hand. They looked majestic and scolded unruly wandering spirits from time to time to maintain order in the city and prevent the bustle from becoming chaotic.

Wu Jiang watched intently, his heart full of novelty, and he forgot his mission for a moment. He even forgot to pull the charm chain in his hand, and his pace subconsciously slowed down.

Until Zhang Yafang, who was beside him, gently tugged at the corner of his clothes, and reminded timidly: "Gui, Mr. Gui Chao, it's time for us to go to the errand? Don't delay your business."

Wu Jiang suddenly came back to his senses, slapped his head, quickly gathered his thoughts, and said with some embarrassment: "Oh, yes, yes! I almost forgot about the business."

Obviously, Zhang Yafang also saw that the master Gui Cha who led him was a pure novice.

He didn't waste any more time and asked a passing Yinzi for directions. He pulled Zhang Yafang and walked quickly towards the Soul Enchanting Division not far away.
